snippet.title: Bocage, a cozy puzzle game
snippet.description:
Bocage is a cozy isometric puzzle game where every farm piece has its own needs. Fill the grid tile by tile. Fence in the cow. Grow wheat around the windmill. Rethink each move as the constraints pile up. No timer, no game over. 

Wishlist it on steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4938320/Bocage_a_cozy_puzzle_game/
